thread:
Maria L: Quick pulse — SilverReach onprem activation. Staging daily smoke failed: builder nodes can't reach egress 52.34.12.8 on 443. Suspect NAT/egress route. Can infra/net owners confirm? Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1429 :eyes:
Samir: On it. Can you paste the curl error or iptables? Also which builder subnet?
Maria L: curl output: 'curl: (7) Failed to connect to 52.34.12.8 port 443: No route to host'
Builder subnet: 10.18.5.0/24
Container logs attached in ticket.
Cheng: Looks like missing NAT on the private gateway. I checked the prod-vpc route table and there's no SNAT for 10.18.0.0/16. I'll check VGW and firewall rules. Assigning to myself to triage.
DeployBot: Canary job silverreach-staging-smoke failed — 3/3 instances timeout. See https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/5234
Alex P: I'll validate the onboarding playbook — firewall defaults to deny. Samir/Cheng, do we want to open egress to 52.34.12.8 or put a proxy? Security will prefer proxy.
Jeff R: Security note — we can't open wide egress. Prefer outbound proxy with mTLS. SilverReach has SAML in place but cert rotation still pending. I'll sketch a short plan.
Samir: For short term let's add a specific egress rule to allow 52.34.12.8:443 from builder subnet, with expiration 24h. Then we can migrate to a proxy pattern.
Cheng: Agree. Adding rule now and will ping when applied.
Maria L: Thanks. Owners for this thread: net @Cheng, infra @Alex P, security @Jeff R. Next milestone = 'staging smoke green' — target EOD today. Ping here when done. Ops runbook: https://redwood.docs/silverreach/onprem-runbook
Alex P: FYI opened PR to update playbook with proxy step: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/472 :thumbsup:
Cheng: Egress rule added. Confirmed curl now returns HTTP/2 200 from builder. Re-ran smoke — seeing a TLS handshake error, cert SAN mismatch.
Jeff R: I'll handle cert rotation — rolling cert update scheduled in 15m, will broadcast to ops and update runbook steps for rotation.
Samir: noted :eyes:
Maria L: Awesome. If any follow-on issues, drop them in OPS-1429. Marking this thread resolved once smoke passes. :white_check_mark:
